title: Adapt
summary: ADAPT' verb transitive [Latin ad. and apto, to fit; Gr.] To make suitable; to fit or suit; as, to adapt an instrument to its uses; we have provision adapted to our wants. It is applied to things mater

inlines.v: ADAPT' verb transitive [Latin ad. and apto, to fit; Gr.] To make suitable; to fit or suit; as, to adapt an instrument to its uses; we have provision adapted to our wants. It is applied to things material or immaterial.
